Third-party components (version 2.08):

  Intel oneAPI Math Kernel Library: BLAS, LAPACK and other optimized
  math routines. Statically linked into the released binaries.
  https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/tools/oneapi/onemkl.html

  Developer Tools)
  Statically linked into the Linux binary; libiomp5md.dll accompanies
  the Windows binary.

  Copyright (C) 1995-2024 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler.
